author: Steve Jobs
story:
Rather than offering a polite platitude, this observation challenges how we navigate our inner lives. Human beings are never a finished product; we exist in perpetual transit between our basic instincts and our highest potential. The tension we feel inside is not a flaw—it is the very engine of self-evolution.

In Steve Jobs's view, genuine strength is not an abstract theory—it is a lived, daily practice. Growing into a fuller version of yourself requires crossing uncertain territory with no safety net. You have to be willing to outgrow the comfort of familiar limitations to step into who you are capable of becoming.
reflectionPrompt: Where in your current routine are you choosing convenient illusion over uncomfortable truth?
